page.notes: Arabic words at the top and inside the text are copied as best read; the last Arabic word of the first line and the word "جعلها" are uncertain. "Fusta[?]" is printed as a long-s-like form (ƒ), which I read as Fusta/Facta and marked as doubtful. The Arabic sign ۞ before "خلق" is a printed ornament or mark. Ink blobs on the page (near "animum", "finis", and at the left margin) are stains, not text. The Google watermark at bottom right is the digitiser's and is left out.
